The agent endpoint is unauthenticated and CORS-open (index.js:1561-1564), so the attacker needs no privileges; the wallet is read and sent outbound, giving VC:H with no integrity or availability effect on the agent itself.","LC":"Attacker-controlled natural language enters through the fetched travel-deals page (index.js:1037-1080, agents.js:464-467) and drives the get_user_wallet plus http_post sink, so the path is Indirect.","CP":"The wallet is read from the agent's static persona definition (agents.js:472) and the injection is not written to any durable store;
